outcome: incidence of abdominal wall endometriosis after caesarean section
treatment outcomes of abdominal wall endometriosis
cohort: 17 patients who underwent excision of abdominal wall endometriosis after caesarean section at the Perinatal Centre of the Institute for the Care of Mother and Child in the Czech Republic between 2003 and 2014
finding: Physicians should be aware of the potential for abdominal wall endometriosis after caesarean section and complete excision is the only curative treatment.
